// why: Copy-paste detection. The FSD layers forbid sideways imports, so the same shape is easy to re-type in two slices instead of hoisting it into the layer below; this is the check that catches that.
// threshold: Measured 0.52% after the first pass. 1.5% leaves room for an honest clone without letting a second copy-paste habit establish itself.
// tokens: 50 tokens / 5 lines is above an import block or a signal-field run, and below any real duplicated function body.
// mode: weak skips comment tokens, so two blocks are clones only when the code matches, not the prose above it.
// ignore-notes: DTOs mirror the wire format and mappers are field-by-field assignments; both are legitimately repetitive and deduping them would couple unrelated endpoints.
